now.title: Taiwan chip side
now.note: Monthly revenue filed on MOPS. Growth = last 3 months vs the same 3 months a year earlier.

cards.title: TWSE semis 半導體業
cards.hist: Confirms about 3 months after price, like WSTS. It never turned down at the 2025 or 2026 lows.

cards.title: TSMC
cards.hist: Its trough-turn fired 41 days after the Mar-2026 low with SMH already +59%; its Feb 10 acceleration turn-up was followed by another 10% fall.

cards.title: TPEx semis (OTC)
cards.hist: Among the closest to price (highest correlation, r 0.73), about a month closer than TWSE semis. Still never ahead of it.

cards.title: Taiwan memory makers
cards.hist: Tracks DRAM prices and SMH almost in step. It did turn down at the Apr-2025 low (−8%), then turned up 2 days after it (one case).

cards.title: Nanya is slowing
cards.pct_text: growth 98th percentile; its acceleration (−46 pp) is in the 4th percentile
cards.hist: The one AI-cycle name slowing. Slowing from very high growth has not been tested as a top signal.

now.title: AI-server side
now.note: ODMs, Quanta, Wiwynn, King Slide and ASPEED lag price by 6-12 months; TWSE computers about 2.

cards.title: TWSE computers 電腦及週邊
cards.hist: Lags price. Its earliest turn signal after the Oct-2022 low still came with SMH +45%.

cards.title: AI server ODMs (6)
cards.sub: Aug 2026 data, public Sep 10 · ex Hon Hai +90.9%
cards.hist: Quanta, Wiwynn, Wistron, Inventec, Gigabyte, Hon Hai. Lags price by about 7 months (2008+; the 2021+ lag cannot be pinned down); picked today as AI winners (hindsight basket).

cards.title: ASPEED
cards.hist: Moved first around the Mar-2026 low (one case), but about half of its acceleration signals were false alarms.

cards.title: Server, ICT and US-bound exports
cards.pct_text: servers +61.7% (76th pct) · ICT +46.3% (−43 pp) · US-bound +26.6% (−50 pp)
cards.hist: Slowing hard. It slowed even harder into the Mar-2026 low (−77 pp), and SMH then rose 85%. It has marked nothing so far.

now.title: Trade
now.note: Taiwan export orders (MOEA) and customs exports (MOF); Korea memory exports.

cards.title: MOEA export orders: electronics
cards.hist: Orders do not lead: price was about 3.8 months ahead of what you could read.
cards.extra: Aug 2026 total orders: $103.0B, +71.4% y/y (MOEA release, Sep 22; not yet in the open-data file).

cards.title: MOF exports: integrated circuits
cards.hist: About a month closer to price than TWSE semis. It read +32% at the Jul-2022 false start too.

cards.title: Korea memory-chip exports
cards.hist: The most in-step of the trade series: about 3 months behind SMH, and level with or slightly behind Micron's share price (r about 0.8). Taiwan memory revenue and TPEx semis are closer to SMH. Never ahead. Very high growth has come before weaker SMH years (r about −0.5, 5-7 independent years per era): exploratory, a late-cycle caution, not timing. Re-checked independently (Oct 3, 2026).
cards.extra: Sep 2026 alone: $54.1B (the trade ministry's memory line), +359% y/y.

now.title: US AI-hardware imports
now.note: US Census general imports in a basket of server, computer-part (incl. GPU boards) and processor lines.

cards.title: Jul 2026 imports
cards.hist: Price moved first: SMH leads these imports by about 5 months, possibly up to a year. They never turned down at the 2025 or 2026 lows (+90% and +132%); after the 2022 low they bottomed 8.5 months later.

now.title: Market signals
now.note: Study readings at the Oct 2 close (they do not update by themselves).

cards.title: S&P 500 breadth washout
cards.sub: 24.8% of S&P 500 stocks above their 50-day average on Oct 2. Borderline: it fired just past its line
cards.pct_text: our own breadth count; the official index can differ slightly
cards.hist: Fired 20, 2 and 6 sessions before the three lows (SMH fell 15% more after the Oct-2022 one). Its false-alarm rate equals a random day's (45% vs 43%).

cards.title: S&P 500 KDJ washout meter
cards.sub: 27.3% of S&P 500 names. The unfinished week to Oct 2 read 27%.
cards.hist: Fired near a market high. The only near-high precedent is Jan 2025, after which SMH fell another 27%.

cards.title: Semis breadth thrust
cards.sub: Chip stocks above their 50-day average: 10.6% (Sep 14) → 83.3% (Oct 1). Semis TURN fired Sep 21. Now 89.4% (Oct 2).
cards.hist: No edge that survives the fair test and the multiple-testing correction (2013+ p 0.08).

cards.title: SMH trend
cards.sub: $630.60 on Oct 2 · +26% vs its 200-day average · +25.1% from the Jul 29 low
cards.hist: Uptrend intact. Trend signals only confirm: they came 32-68% above the lows in 2022 and 2025.

now.title: Chart indicators on SMH
now.note: KDJ, MACD-V and OBV-MACD on closed weekly, 2-week and monthly candles.

cards.title: 2-week KDJ golden cross
cards.sub: SMH closed $630.60 on Oct 2. An intraday price is not a firing.
cards.hist: KDJ crosses fired within about 2 weeks of every low, and the same way after failed bounces.

cards.title: 1-month KDJ golden cross
cards.unit: close needed at the end of October
cards.sub: Weekly K above D since Sep 4; 2-week coil Sep 25; monthly coil Sep 30.
cards.hist: Neither coil had an edge before (2-week −3.4 / +0.2 pts; monthly +16.6 / −9.4 pts, 2021+ / 2013-20).

cards.title: MACD-V weekly
cards.hist: Momentum-on is late confirmation: it came 110, 59 and 18 sessions after the three lows.

cards.title: OBV-MACD weekly
cards.hist: OBV flips came within 20 sessions of 6 of 6 real starts and 6 of 6 false starts.

now.title: Macro
now.note: The 2025 and 2026 turns came as the shock eased (in 2026 only on the third de-escalation headline). In 2022 the low came 18 sessions before the macro relief. Two cases, not a tested signal.

cards.title: Iran war
cards.unit: resumed in July, escalated in September
cards.sub: Brent about $103 at the end of Q3 (+42% for the quarter; CNBC, Oct 1)
cards.hist: The Mar-2026 low turned on the third de-escalation headline; the first two (Mar 9, Mar 23) were each followed by another 7-8% drop.

cards.title: 10-year Treasury
cards.sub: Down 5 bp on the day, after briefly touching levels last seen in 2002 (CNBC, Oct 1)
cards.hist: Rates explained only about 1 point of the Sep 14 chip drop; most of it was chip-specific.

cards.title: Fed
cards.sub: First hike since 2023, 12-0 vote. Next meeting Oct 27-28.
cards.hist: SMH still rose 12.1% in the 5 days after the hike: macro relief is not required for a chip rally.

cards.title: Foreign investors in Taiwan
cards.sub: Sep 2026, public Sep 30: Jul-Sep −NT$424bn, after −NT$1.1tn in May-Jul
cards.hist: They sold into every low. Their net buying turned positive with SMH already +24-28% off it, and after the 2026 low they kept selling on balance (−NT$257bn over 13 weeks). The cross-above-zero signal fails 2013-20.

cards.title: Korea chip exports, Sep 1–20
cards.pct_text: a record: the highest 20-day print of 118 since Aug 2016
meta: $34.1B in 20 days, also a record (15.5 vs 16.5 working days a year earlier: about +283% per working day)
full month, first print (Oct 1): +263%, $60.3B; Aug final (Sep 15): +206%
cards.hist: Confirms about 3 months after SMH and 1 month after Micron's share price. It was positive at the 2025 and 2026 lows and stayed at +181% to +188%, just under its May record (+202%), through the June top and the July drop; release-day moves were no bigger than usual and did not track the print.
cards.extra: Korea's total exports: +78% y/y over Sep 1–20 (+83.5% for the month, 21.5 vs 24 working days).

cards.title: Korea memory exports
meta: September alone +359%, $54.1B (the trade ministry's memory line)
cards.hist: Moves with Micron (r about 0.8, about a month apart) and sits about 3 months behind SMH. It kept accelerating through the June top and the July drop; very high readings have come before weaker SMH years in both eras: late-cycle caution, not timing.

cards.title: Korea system-chip exports
cards.hist: The logic side lags SMH by about 8 months and has not joined the memory boom. Its 2022 acceleration turn-ups (not marked on the panel) came before further 18–35% falls, and its Feb 2026 trough-turn before another 11%.

cards.title: SK Hynix vs SMH
meta: ₩1,841,000 on Oct 2: 37% below its Jun 22 high in won, 29% below its Jun 25 high in dollars
SMH 5.7% and Micron 11.4% below their 1-year highs (Oct 2)
cards.hist: Moves with SMH and Micron in the same week, no lead. It bottomed with SMH at 5 of 7 lows since 2016 (3 of 4 since 2021), and 2–3 weeks early in 2016 and 2022; it topped the same day as SMH in June 2026 in won (3 sessions later in dollars). Its strength vs SMH has not forecast SMH (exploratory).

cards.title: Samsung vs SMH
meta: ₩276,000 on Oct 2: 24% below its Jun 18 high in won, 15% below its high in dollars
cards.hist: Moves with SMH (12-month r 0.76), no lead. It held up against SMH into the 2025 and 2026 lows (top 1% of readings) but was flat against it at the June top; no forecasting value found (exploratory).

cards.title: Won vs dollar
cards.sub: USD/KRW 1,356.8 on Oct 1 (London close); 1,554 at the Jun 8 peak
cards.pct_text: 99th percentile since 2013; only Jan–Feb 2023 saw a bigger 3-month gain
meta: KOSPI 6,971 (Oct 1): 23.5% below its Jun 22 record, +102% over 12 months
cards.hist: The won hit its low within 12 sessions after SMH's low at 4 of 6 lows (not 2018 or 2026). After the biggest 3-month won rallies, sharp SMH falls were rarer than usual, but that missed the pre-registered bar.

cards.title: Korea DRAM / flash price index
cards.sub: Bank of Korea producer / export price items
cards.hist: Not shown: it needs a free Bank of Korea ECOS API key, which has not been set up.

right_now: Korea's chip exports Sep 1–20 +259% y/y ($34.1B, a record; 15.5 vs 16.5 working days a year earlier: about +283% per working day); September memory exports +359% ($54.1B; 3-month +311%).

Seoul close Oct 2: SK Hynix 37% below its Jun 22 high in won (29% below its dollar high), Samsung 24% (15% in dollars), KOSPI 23.5% (Oct 1); SMH 5.7% and Micron 11.4% below their highs at the Oct 2 US close.
The won +14% on the dollar in 3 months (99th percentile since 2013).

Next print: Oct 1–10 chip exports on Oct 12 (estimated). About 5.5 working days vs 3.5 a year ago (estimated from the holiday calendar), so the y/y is flattered (Chuseok fell in that window a year ago).
